title: Arm-aware stock Ministral quantization frontier
state: candidate universe and decision policy frozen while E10d is running and before any E10d or new-variant external result is observed
scope: An exploratory quality and native Arm service frontier across all nine stock quantizations identified in the maximum-ambition campaign. E10d supplies the exact Q4_K_M anchor and Q4_0 diagnostic control only if its frozen validator passes. The eight remaining candidates are evaluated without changing the E10d task, sample, tokenizer, metric, or serial scoring contract.
hypothesis: At least one stock format is non-dominated against Q4_K_M on external quality, package size, native Arm service throughput, peak RSS, or readiness. IQ4_NL is a specific Arm mechanism candidate because pinned b10216 contains a NEON dot-product repack path for that type; this is a hypothesis, not a result.

quality_phase.prerequisite: The E10d serial exact-token adapter, tokenizer parity, raw retention, and aggregate validation must pass unchanged.
quality_phase.reuse_rule: Reuse E10d Q4_K_M and Q4_0 results only byte-for-byte after E10d passes; never rerun them merely to obtain a preferable outcome.

exploratory_frontier_rule.coordinates: Maximize each of the three frozen quality coordinates while minimizing model bytes. No weighted quality score is used for dominance.
exploratory_frontier_rule.dominance: A candidate dominates another only when it is no worse on all three quality coordinates and model bytes, and strictly better on at least one.
exploratory_frontier_rule.ties: Exact quality ties retain the smaller model. Exact size and quality ties retain both as identical frontier points.
exploratory_frontier_rule.poor_result_rule: Every result remains in the full table even if dominated, below Q4_0, or unexpectedly broken.
exploratory_frontier_rule.shortlist: Advance every non-dominated quality-size point to matched native service measurement; do not impose a post-hoc cap.

service_phase.service: Exact E7c one-slot OpenSSL-off b10216 recipe without the E10b response patch, because end-product generation service performance is the target.
service_phase.workload: Exact E9a 30-task service workload and quality checks, with fresh processes and reverse-balanced Q4_K_M anchor ordering.
measurements: model buffer and repack mechanism logs
service_phase.frontier_coordinates: Quality coordinates, model bytes, median throughput, median latency, CPU seconds per request, peak RSS, and readiness remain separate; no weighted score.
service_phase.promotion: A stock variant can become a candidate tier only after it is non-dominated in matched native service evidence and then passes a separately frozen sealed quality confirmation.

sealed_confirmation.rule: Select and freeze a new licensed task/sample holdout before inspecting service-phase outcomes, then run only the mechanically selected shortlist. The existing 30-task admission contract remains unchanged.

negative_result_rule: Retain model download/hash failure, unsupported quant type, load failure, tokenizer mismatch, scoring failure, low or mixed quality, regression against Q4_K_M or Q4_0, repack absence, performance regression, memory regression, or readiness regression without changing candidates, tasks, samples, metrics, or dominance rules.
claim_boundary: E11a can construct an exploratory stock-quant quality/size frontier and a separately matched native Arm service frontier for the exact pinned repository and runtime. It cannot promote a replacement model without a new sealed confirmation, rewrite the original 30-task admission contract, attribute format performance solely to one kernel, or make energy, PMU, local-device, fleet, cost, mixed-quant, imatrix, pruning, or other-runtime claims.
